'''Zygian's Banking Concern''' in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was a branch office of [[Zygian's Banking Concern]], a savings and loan corporation whose headquarters was on [[Treylon II]]. The branch was managed by [[Givvers]] circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It offered 15% interest loans, which compared to typical Mos Eisley loan shark rates of 300% or more was a good deal. People skipping out on their payments were a constant problem, to the point where the branch opened up an unofficial pawn shop selling collateral goods left behind.<ref name="GG7" />
